values.name: Luce de Michelena
values.bio: Luce de Michelena is a French freediver from Bayonne who competes in the pool disciplines. As a student, she took a gap year to train around the world, from Bali and Dahab to Canada, France and Costa Rica, working toward becoming a Molchanovs freediving instructor and entering her first competitions in static and dynamic apnea.
